assumptions.statement: The site and three key-area polygons are provisional constraints derived from the repository site package, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All area values and spatial allocations are recomputable design-package properties and must be regenerated when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Approved FAR, height, setbacks, road redlines, building density and total floor area are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Development-intensity controls remain unknown; no rendering or concept envelope may be read as an approved control.

assumptions.statement: Surveyed building footprints, structural condition, heritage value and ownership are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Retain, interface retrofit, adaptive reuse and selective-new decisions remain methods and candidate envelopes rather than parcel instructions.

assumptions.statement: Official rail exits, underground structures, passenger flows, road geometry, crossings, parking and accessibility audits are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: G0 routes and station-city nodes identify design questions; capacity, dimensions and approved alignments are not claimed.

assumptions.statement: Municipal utilities, drainage, flood, fire access, power, communications and equipment-clearance data are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: G4 service bands, rain gardens and AI infrastructure require engineering coordination before implementation.

assumptions.statement: Operators, budgets, opening hours, data controllers, safety responsibilities and public-review mechanisms are not assigned.
assumptions.impact: Time-of-day operations and AI scenarios remain pilot protocols with non-AI fallbacks, human override and exit mechanisms.
